title: Unisex Bulldog – Walked Once. Never Again. Hoodie

seo.title: Bulldog Hoodie – Walked Once. Never Again.
seo.description: A funny bulldog hoodie for English bulldog owners: WALKED ONCE. NEVER AGAIN. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

WALKED ONCE. NEVER AGAIN. is the bulldog hoodie for the English bulldog owner whose dog has retired from walks, worn on the short loop around the block, on the couch and as a gift from friends who have carried the dog home.

WALKED ONCE. runs across the top in heavy rounded capitals and NEVER AGAIN. stacks in two huge lines below. Between them a stocky English bulldog lies flopped belly-down on a patch of sidewalk, legs splayed flat and jowls on the pavement, one tired eye open, a slack red leash trailing off to the side.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the sidewalk scene; Sand gets dark brown and deep rust lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this bulldog hoodie warm enough for short walks and cool mornings?
Yes. The Walked Once. Never Again. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for short walks, cool mornings and couch evenings.

How does the Walked Once. Never Again. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for an English bulldog owner?
It is a natural one. Every English bulldog owner has been out-stubborned on a walk, so it lands with bulldog rescuers, dog-park friends and the family that has carried the dog home. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the sidewalk scene sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Walked Once. Never Again. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
